.TH "NPM-INSTALL-TEST" "1" "March 2026" "NPM@10.9.7" ""
.SH "NAME"
\fBnpm-install-test\fR - Install package(s) and run tests
.SS "Synopsis"
.P
.RS 2
.nf
npm install-test \[lB]<package-spec> ...\[rB]

alias: it
.fi
.RE
.SS "Description"
.P
